import_save_recovery.name: a failed import checkpoint stops further documents and Save retries the retained pages
import_save_recovery.scope: Real browser UI with controlled synthetic native adapter, not disk-failure injection in the native application.
asserted: The first imported document retains two new pages after its save fails.
Only one native import call occurs; the next document is not started.
No active native call or pending import remains.
The workspace displays Save failed and its recovery instructions.
Explicit Save retry preserves the original three pages plus both imported pages and their exact source/archive URIs.
All changes saved appears only after the retry succeeds.

history.scope: Node model/history CPU and memory receipt; excludes WebView rendering, page pixels and native model inference.
history.timing_gate: No fragile wall-clock threshold. Integrity and history-byte bounds are required.
history.memory_observation: The 1,000-page optimized process had higher sampled and high-water memory than baseline. The 5,000-page optimized process had lower sampled and high-water memory. No universal memory reduction is claimed.
history.interpretation: Single hosted Node benchmark receipt; no WebView paint, page pixels or native model inference. Compare exact measurements in history-benchmark.json.
